UserPreference.title: UserPreference
UserPreference.description: User-scoped Lumina gallery theme and layout preferences synced across devices.

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

gridColumns.description: Number of columns in the photo grid (2 to 4).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudFavorite.title: CloudFavorite
CloudFavorite.description: User-scoped favorite photo metadata record synced in Firestore.

photoKey.description: Stable identifier for the photo (Drive file ID, local URI, or curated sample key).

sourceType.description: Origin source of the favorited photo.

driveFileId.description: Optional Google Drive file ID if backed by Drive.

CloudAlbum.title: CloudAlbum
CloudAlbum.description: User-scoped custom album definition synced across devices.

accentHex.description: Hex color string for album badge.

photoKeys.description: Bounded list of photo keys belonging to this album (max 100).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when album was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when album was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user Lumina gallery preferences and profile metadata.

/users/{userId}/cloudFavorites/{favorite.description: User-scoped favorited photo references including Google Drive items.
